title: tc-subagent-list
description: The sub-agents a session started, grouped Active and Done, each with its mark, what it's doing and a live clock.

heading.description: The heading; empty leaves the header out

agents.description: The sub-agents, in the order to show them within each group – newest first reads best

selected.description: The id of the chosen agent. Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

now.description: The time now, epoch ms; by default the element's own clock, which ticks

bare.description: Drop the tray and card, for a place that already has one

labels.description: The words it uses, merged over the defaults

name.description: What it was asked to do, short – "Review forms current"

activity.description: What it's doing now, or why it stopped – "awaiting command message"

startedAt.description: When it started, epoch ms – an active agent's clock runs from here

endedAt.description: When it finished, failed or stopped, epoch ms – a done agent shows how long ago

mark.description: What its mark is drawn from, when not its id – to give agents the same mark across sessions

SubagentStatus.description: Where a sub-agent is: running and waiting are Active; done, failed and stopped are Done
